messages.note: _dispatch_tensor_grad_hooks: a returned tensor replaces only that tensor's .grad

cards.title: How the order is chosen
items: topo_order is the reverse of an iterative DFS post-order over next_edges
No dependency counters, no ready queue: one single-threaded pass

cards.title: Version check
items: forward stamps input versions with set_saved_versions
An in-place change to a saved input raises VersionMismatch

cards.title: Releasing the graph
items: retain_graph=False frees saved tensors node by node
create_graph=True forces retain_graph and takes backward_for_graph
